searchText: Is there any documentation on when which engine method should be used? Hi folks, i have a question regarding EIP-4844. I see that the kzg commitment computation for proof verification happens only during addition of a blob tx along with its blob to the txpool. It doesn't happen during block building nor blob building. Am i right in my understanding here? I understand that KZG commitments computation are something that is going to be expensive going forward, i want to cross check where in the protocol we are doing this expensive computation as far as i can tell, i only see it in the execution layer and it happens only during addition to the blob tx pool. I guess its this <https://github.com/mkalinin/execution-apis/blob/b6c83481a5e64ea340b222609d6b7ad8c9d969a6/src/engine/cancun.md>
